rules.statement: A deed of gift by a Muslim donor cannot be revoked once it is expressed to be irrevocable, unless there was no delivery of possession.
rules.supporting_quote: "Under the Kandyan law gifts are ordinarily revocable but this Court has held and it is now settled law that when such a gift is expressed to be irrevocable the donor may not revoke it. I can see no reason why the principle of these decisions should not be applied to the case of gifts between Muslims."

meta.parties: Rafeeka Et Al. v. Mohamad Sathuck
